fieldNotes.truckGate: Main entrance road off NW Loop 286 (~33.6865,-95.5622) with a Campbell's sign; perimeter fence around the plant. Gate is inside, set back from the public road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible from public-road Street View (plant sits far back behind grass buffer and fence). Marked false / remoteGs true at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail line / spur runs along the east side of the plant; rail cars visible in imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Very large trailer drop yard on the NW with many rows of parked trailers (100+).
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Multiple dock banks; trailers backed into dock face on the NW warehouse and main plant. ~50 estimate banded 50+, low confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large multi-building manufacturing complex plus separate NW warehouse blocks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance road and ample paved internal yard.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box ~1170m N-S x ~510m E-W.
